pages.text: Each of the three dungeon bosses drops a unique trophy: the $(item)Sentinel Eye$() (Onyx Sentinel), the $(item)Warlock Sigil$() (Infernal Warlock) and the $(item)Champion Crown$() (Withered Champion). Together they make the $(item)Sealed Heart$().$(br2)Right-click it $(l)in the Nether only$(): the Heart of the Nether awakens above you.
pages.title: Boss final

pages.text: 600 HP, flies. Fireball volleys, a fiery $(l)pulse$() that throws you back, telegraphed $(l)meteor rains$(). At 66% and 33% it summons guards and hides behind a shield until they fall. Last phase: $(l)lava geysers$().
